name: dataset_create
summary: A long-running collection that runs every day (or hourly / weekly), adds new rows and refreshes the existing ones, kept as an Excel / CSV / Markdown table: competitor listings or prices over weeks, a growing creator list, daily social sentiment, a price history ('collect … every day into a table', 'build me a spreadsheet of … and keep it updated', 'jeden Tag ergänzen'). For a one-off list use scrape; for alerts on new listings use monitor_create.

args.name: string: short label
args.fields: string[]: columns to collect (scrape; include url)
args.detail_fields: string[]: extra columns read from each row's own page, a slice per run (scrape, optional)
args.question: string (social)
args.monitor: string: which monitor or price tracker (monitor)
